name: suspender push up
description: A push-up with the feet in suspension straps and the hands on the floor, challenging the chest, arms and core.
instructions: Place your feet in the suspension straps and set your hands on the floor beneath your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your body in one line.
Lower your chest toward the floor while keeping the straps steady and your elbows at a comfortable angle.
Press back up to straight arms without letting your hips sag.
